what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Ghana, as counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 3932 people displaced by conflict and violence.
UNHCR's last figure for IDPs of concern in Ghana is from 1994.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Ghana in these years, so it does not say why people were displaced.
IDMC's disaster records for Ghana list floods and storms.

when.text: IDMC's figure stayed between 3158 and 5000 from 2018 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 7414 new displacements by conflict and violence: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Ghana.
